name: llm-wiki-canvas
description: A local-first visual knowledge workspace for coding agents and Obsidian.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && tsup src/cli/index.ts --format esm --clean
scripts.test:release-matrix: pnpm audit:secrets && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm validate:skill && pnpm test:hosts && pnpm test:package
scripts.demo:build: tsx src/cli/index.ts build examples/atlas-wiki --graph public/graph.json --canvas examples/atlas-wiki/Atlas.canvas --excalidraw examples/atlas-wiki/Atlas.excalidraw --generated-at 2026-08-10T00:00:00.000Z
scripts.demo:build:zh: tsx src/cli/index.ts build examples/agent-trends-zh --graph public/agent-trends-zh.json --canvas examples/agent-trends-zh/Trends.canvas --excalidraw examples/agent-trends-zh/Trends.excalidraw --generated-at 2026-08-14T00:00:00.000Z
scripts.generated:check: git diff --exit-code -- public/graph.json public/agent-trends-zh.json public/okf-graph.json examples/atlas-wiki/Atlas.canvas examples/atlas-wiki/Atlas.excalidraw examples/agent-trends-zh/Trends.canvas examples/agent-trends-zh/Trends.excalidraw docs/agent-compatibility.md
scripts.context:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts context examples/atlas-wiki --focus 'Human Review' --depth 1 --max-pages 4 --max-words 400 --format json -o .lwc/atlas-context.json
scripts.proposal:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts proposal create examples/atlas-wiki --from examples/proposal-draft --summary 'Demonstrate reviewed knowledge changes' --created-at 2026-08-10T00:00:00.000Z -o .lwc/atlas-demo-proposal.json && tsx src/cli/index.ts proposal show .lwc/atlas-demo-proposal.json
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm demo:build && pnpm demo:build:zh && pnpm okf:build && pnpm report:demo && pnpm context:demo && pnpm okf:demo && pnpm agents:matrix && pnpm proposal:demo && pnpm generated:check && pnpm build && pnpm validate:skill && pnpm test:hosts
scripts.verify: pnpm audit:secrets && pnpm audit:deps && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm check && pnpm test:package && pnpm test:site && pnpm test:e2e:prod && pnpm test:e2e:live
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm pack --dry-run
